name: scan_dependencies
description: Scan all dependencies of a Maven project and build mapping index from class names to JAR packages

name: decompile_class
description: Decompile specified Java class file and return Java source code

className.description: Fully qualified name of the Java class to decompile, e.g., com.example.QueryBizOrderDO

useCache.description: Whether to use cache, default true

cfrPath.description: JAR package path of CFR decompilation tool, optional

name: analyze_class
description: Analyze structure, methods, fields and other information of a Java class

className.description: Fully qualified name of the Java class to analyze
